subject: reps needs from RepSession and Profile v2
body: Please add to RepSession, beyond the mvp.md first cut: profileId, kind (full|anchor-only), startedAt/endedAt, steps[] as {kind, plannedMs, startedAt, endedAt, delivered}, scriptHash, anchorPaired, recoveryCensored, signalSource (simulator|hr-strap|none), outcome (completed|user-stop|safety-stop|timeout), repIndex, and trigger as {kind, detectionEventId?}. Without kind/anchorPaired/outcome the installed rule can't be computed; without signalSource cue-vs-sham recovery mixes sources. Also: an optional per-emotion 'leverage' line in Profile v2 (Robbins step 2, spoken in the focus step). For API.md, reps.run needs to return a handle {session: Promise<RepSession>, stop()} so the stop button works. Full table: reps/PLAN.md section 3 and 6 on lane/reps.
